verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a structured llms.txt index at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Every docs page is also served as raw Markdown, with agentTools frontmatter pointing back to that index, and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema can be retrieved without authentication. Together these give an agent a clear entry point and machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on how agents should use these resources, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
